item.title: How stable are self-description rankings from month to month?

item.title: The Ten Largest Male–Female Endorsement Gaps
item.description: The widest gaps in Ipseity Daily were for sex and gender labels, pronouns, and family roles. The word male had the largest gap among eligible terms, followed closely by woman and man. Those terms are examples of what Ipseity Daily calls signifiers.
